schema_version: case_checklist_v1
case_unit_id: MarkorCreateNote
domain: androidworld
task_id: MarkorCreateNote
native:
  user_goal:
    text: Create a new note in Markor with the dispatched file name and the dispatched text.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/single/markor.py::MarkorCreateNote
    - official/install/android_world/task_metadata.json::line 204
  benchmark_success:
    text: 'Native success requires both runner completion and evaluator success: retained evidence shows the episode reached the runner''s done gate, and evaluator-visible Markor filesystem state shows /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/<file_name> exists with contents that fuzzy-match the dispatched text.'
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/suite_utils.py::_run_task
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/single/markor.py::MarkorCreateNote.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/env/device_constants.py::MARKOR_DATA
    - official/install/android_world/utils/fuzzy_match_lib.py::fuzzy_match
  checked_by:
    text: AndroidWorld runner done-gate plus MarkorCreateNote delegating to file_validators.CreateFile on MARKOR_DATA.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/suite_utils.py::_run_task
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/single/markor.py::MarkorCreateNote.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/env/device_constants.py::MARKOR_DATA
  decisive_artifacts:
  - artifact: Retained episode completion evidence
    question: Does the retained episode record show the run reached the runner's done gate?
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/suite_utils.py::_run_task
  - artifact: Retained post-run Markor filesystem snapshot or pulled target file
    question: Does /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/<file_name> exist after the run, and if so do its readable contents fuzzy-match the dispatched text?
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/env/device_constants.py::MARKOR_DATA
    - official/install/android_world/utils/fuzzy_match_lib.py::fuzzy_match
  success_if:
  - text: Stored evidence shows done=true, and stored Markor filesystem evidence shows /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/<file_name> exists with contents that fuzzy-match the dispatched text.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/suite_utils.py::_run_task
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/env/device_constants.py::MARKOR_DATA
    - official/install/android_world/utils/fuzzy_match_lib.py::fuzzy_match
  fail_if:
  - text: Stored completion evidence shows done=false.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/suite_utils.py::_run_task
  - text: Retained Markor filesystem evidence shows no file named <file_name> exists under /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor after the run.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/env/device_constants.py::MARKOR_DATA
  - text: Retained readable contents of /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/<file_name> do not fuzzy-match the dispatched text.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/utils/fuzzy_match_lib.py::fuzzy_match
  undecided_if:
  - text: Completion-gate evidence is missing or ambiguous, and retained Markor filesystem evidence is missing or insufficient to determine both target-file existence and whether readable contents match the dispatched text under the evaluator's fuzzy-match rule.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/suite_utils.py::_run_task
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/utils/fuzzy_match_lib.py::fuzzy_match
  - text: A retained Markor snapshot shows the target file path but not readable post-run contents, so the CreateFile content check cannot be reconstructed from stored evidence alone.
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
stronger:
  additional_conditions:
  - id: exact_note_text_not_fuzzy
    text: 'Stronger than native: the created note''s substantive body text should match the dispatched text exactly, not merely pass the evaluator''s fuzzy similarity check.'
    rationale: The official task asks for the note to be created "with the following text," but the released evaluator accepts approximate matches via fuzzy_match, so native success can over-credit near-miss note contents.
    decisive_artifacts:
    - artifact: Retained post-run contents of /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/<file_name>
      question: Do the retained contents show the dispatched text exactly in substance, rather than only approximately matching it?
      support:
      - official/install/android_world/task_evals/single/markor.py::MarkorCreateNote
      - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
      - official/install/android_world/utils/fuzzy_match_lib.py::fuzzy_match
    support:
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/single/markor.py::MarkorCreateNote
    - official/install/android_world/task_evals/common_validators/file_validators.py::CreateFile.is_successful
    - official/install/android_world/utils/fuzzy_match_lib.py::fuzzy_match

ways to complete a task, pick the easiest one. Also when something does not work as expected (due to various reasons), sometimes a simple retry can solve the problem, but if it doesn't (you can see that from the history), try to switch to other solutions.\n- Sometimes you may need to navigate the phone to gather information needed to complete the task, for example if user asks \"what is my schedule tomorrow\", then you may want to open the calendar app (using the `open_app` action), look up information there, answer user's question (using the `answer` action) and finish (using the `status` action with complete as goal_status).\n- For requests that are questions (or chat messages), remember to use the `answer` action to reply to user explicitly before finish! UI element 55: UIElement(text='本系统在接触具体 agent outcomes 和 per-record released evaluator results 之前，依据每个 case 的官方 user goal、task、policy、released evaluator/oracle 的正式语义、必要的 state schema，以及可用的 artifact inventory，制定并锁定证据 checklist；锁定后不得根据 agent outcomes 修改。官方 task、user intent 或 policy 中具有具体、case-specific 的 source support，但超出 evaluator/oracle 所操作化 native criterion 的要求，作为 stronger-measurement conditions 单独记录；没有此类官方依据、仅凭审核者主观判断提出的要求不进入 checklist 或评分。 Benchmark 按原流程运行后，系统原样保留该 case 的运行产物和 released evaluator label，例如 success 或 fail。在 evidence scoring 阶段，系统向 scorer 隔离该 record 的 released evaluator label，以及能够等价泄露该结果的 component evaluator outputs。Scorer 依据锁定的 checklist 和其余 retained execution evidence，独立判断证据是否建立 native success、建立 native failure，或不足以决定 native claim，并相应给出 S、F 或 U。 Evidence scoring 完成后，系统再将 native evidence verdict 与预先保存的 released evaluator label 进行比较。不一致记录进入独立的 record-level 审核，但不一致本身不自动构成 benchmark conflict。只有 retained artifacts 与明确的 source pointers 表明原 benchmark 的 task、target construction、evaluator、oracle，或 reward wiring/aggregation 实际检查了不同于 benchmark 看起来声称报告的 outcome 时，才将该记录标记为 confirmed benchmark conflict。 Stronger-measurement 结果独立报告。Stronger failure 本身不表示 benchmark 判错，native S 与 stronger F 的组合也不能自动推导出 benchmark conflict。 ', content_description=None, class_name='android.widget.TextView', bbox=None, bbox_pixels=BoundingBox(x_min=435, x_max=718, y_min=1548, y_max=1602), hint_text=None, is_checked=False, is_checkable=False, is_clickable=False, is_editable=False, is_enabled=True, is_focused=False, is_focusable=False, is_long_clickable=False, is_scrollable=False, is_selected=False, is_visible=True, package_name='com.google.android.inputmethod.latin', resource_name='com.google.android.inputmethod.latin:id/0_resource_name_obfuscated', tooltip=None, resource_id=None, metadata=None)

Here are some useful guidelines you need to follow:
General
- Usually there will be multiple ways to complete a task, pick the easiest one. Also when something does not work as expected (due to various reasons), sometimes a simple retry can solve the problem, but if it doesn't (you can see that from the history), try to switch to other solutions.
- Sometimes you may need to navigate the phone to gather information needed to complete the task, for example if user asks "what is my schedule tomorrow", then you may want to open the calendar app (using the `open_app` action), look up information there, answer user's question (using the `answer` action) and finish (using the `status` action with complete as goal_status).
- For requests that are questions (or chat messages), remember to use the `answer` action to reply to user explicitly before finish! Merely displaying the answer on the screen is NOT sufficient (unless the goal is something like "show me ...").
- If the desired state is already achieved (e.g., enabling Wi-Fi when it's already on), you can just complete the task.
Action Related
- Use the `open_app` action whenever you want to open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed), do not use the app drawer to open an app unless all other ways have failed.
- Use the `input_text` action whenever you want to type something (including password) instead of clicking characters on the keyboard one by one. Sometimes there is some default text in the text field you want to type in, remember to delete them before typing.
- For `click`, `long_press` and `input_text`, the index parameter you pick must be VISIBLE in the screenshot and also in the UI element list given to you (some elements in the list may NOT be visible on the screen so you can not interact with them).
- Consider exploring the screen by using the `scroll` action with different directions to reveal additional content.
- The direction parameter for the `scroll` action can be confusing sometimes as it's opposite to swipe, for example, to view content at the bottom, the `scroll` direction should be set to "down". It has been observed that you have difficulties in choosing the correct direction, so if one does not work, try the opposite as well.
Text Related Operations
- Normally to select some text on the screen: <i> Enter text selection mode by long pressing the area where the text is, then some of the words near the long press point will be selected (highlighted with two pointers indicating the range) and usually a text selection bar will also appear with options like `copy`, `paste`, `select all`, etc. <ii> Select the exact text you need. Usually the text selected from the previous step is NOT the one you want, you need to adjust the range by dragging the two pointers. If you want to select all text in the text field, simply click the `select all` button in the bar.
- At this point, you don't have the ability to drag something around the screen, so in general you can not select arbitrary text.

UI element 55: UIElement(text='本系统在接触具体 agent outcomes 和 per-record released evaluator results 之前，依据每个 case 的官方 user goal、task、policy、released evaluator/oracle 的正式语义、必要的 state schema，以及可用的 artifact inventory，制定并锁定证据 checklist；锁定后不得根据 agent outcomes 修改。官方 task、user intent 或 policy 中具有具体、case-specific 的 source support，但超出 evaluator/oracle 所操作化 native criterion 的要求，作为 stronger-measurement conditions 单独记录；没有此类官方依据、仅凭审核者主观判断提出的要求不进入 checklist 或评分。 Benchmark 按原流程运行后，系统原样保留该 case 的运行产物和 released evaluator label，例如 success 或 fail。在 evidence scoring 阶段，系统向 scorer 隔离该 record 的 released evaluator label，以及能够等价泄露该结果的 component evaluator outputs。Scorer 依据锁定的 checklist 和其余 retained execution evidence，独立判断证据是否建立 native success、建立 native failure，或不足以决定 native claim，并相应给出 S、F 或 U。 Evidence scoring 完成后，系统再将 native evidence verdict 与预先保存的 released evaluator label 进行比较。不一致记录进入独立的 record-level 审核，但不一致本身不自动构成 benchmark conflict。只有 retained artifacts 与明确的 source pointers 表明原 benchmark 的 task、target construction、evaluator、oracle，或 reward wiring/aggregation 实际检查了不同于 benchmark 看起来声称报告的 outcome 时，才将该记录标记为 confirmed benchmark conflict。 Stronger-measurement 结果独立报告。Stronger failure 本身不表示 benchmark 判错，native S 与 stronger F 的组合也不能自动推导出 benchmark conflict。 ', content_description=None, class_name='android.widget.TextView', bbox=None, bbox_pixels=BoundingBox(x_min=435, x_max=718, y_min=1548, y_max=1602), hint_text=None, is_checked=False, is_checkable=False, is_clickable=False, is_editable=False, is_enabled=True, is_focused=False, is_focusable=False, is_long_clickable=False, is_scrollable=False, is_selected=False, is_visible=True, package_name='com.google.android.inputmethod.latin', resource_name='com.google.android.inputmethod.latin:id/0_resource_name_obfuscated', tooltip=None, resource_id=None, metadata=None)

UI element 55: UIElement(text='本系统在接触具体 agent outcomes 和 per-record released evaluator results 之前，依据每个 case 的官方 user goal、task、policy、released evaluator/oracle 的正式语义、必要的 state schema，以及可用的 artifact inventory，制定并锁定证据 checklist；锁定后不得根据 agent outcomes 修改。官方 task、user intent 或 policy 中具有具体、case-specific 的 source support，但超出 evaluator/oracle 所操作化 native criterion 的要求，作为 stronger-measurement conditions 单独记录；没有此类官方依据、仅凭审核者主观判断提出的要求不进入 checklist 或评分。 Benchmark 按原流程运行后，系统原样保留该 case 的运行产物和 released evaluator label，例如 success 或 fail。在 evidence scoring 阶段，系统向 scorer 隔离该 record 的 released evaluator label，以及能够等价泄露该结果的 component evaluator outputs。Scorer 依据锁定的 checklist 和其余 retained execution evidence，独立判断证据是否建立 native success、建立 native failure，或不足以决定 native claim，并相应给出 S、F 或 U。 Evidence scoring 完成后，系统再将 native evidence verdict 与预先保存的 released evaluator label 进行比较。不一致记录进入独立的 record-level 审核，但不一致本身不自动构成 benchmark conflict。只有 retained artifacts 与明确的 source pointers 表明原 benchmark 的 task、target construction、evaluator、oracle，或 reward wiring/aggregation 实际检查了不同于 benchmark 看起来声称报告的 outcome 时，才将该记录标记为 confirmed benchmark conflict。 Stronger-measurement 结果独立报告。Stronger failure 本身不表示 benchmark 判错，native S 与 stronger F 的组合也不能自动推导出 benchmark conflict。 ', content_description=None, class_name='android.widget.TextView', bbox=None, bbox_pixels=BoundingBox(x_min=435, x_max=718, y_min=1548, y_max=1602), hint_text=None, is_checked=False, is_checkable=False, is_clickable=False, is_editable=False, is_enabled=True, is_focused=False, is_focusable=False, is_long_clickable=False, is_scrollable=False, is_selected=False, is_visible=True, package_name='com.google.android.inputmethod.latin', resource_name='com.google.android.inputmethod.latin:id/0_resource_name_obfuscated', tooltip=None, resource_id=None, metadata=None)

Here are some useful guidelines you need to follow:
General
- Usually there will be multiple ways to complete a task, pick the easiest one. Also when something does not work as expected (due to various reasons), sometimes a simple retry can solve the problem, but if it doesn't (you can see that from the history), try to switch to other solutions.
- Sometimes you may need to navigate the phone to gather information needed to complete the task, for example if user asks "what is my schedule tomorrow", then you may want to open the calendar app (using the `open_app` action), look up information there, answer user's question (using the `answer` action) and finish (using the `status` action with complete as goal_status).
- For requests that are questions (or chat messages), remember to use the `answer` action to reply to user explicitly before finish! Merely displaying the answer on the screen is NOT sufficient (unless the goal is something like "show me ...").
- If the desired state is already achieved (e.g., enabling Wi-Fi when it's already on), you can just complete the task.
Action Related
- Use the `open_app` action whenever you want to open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed), do not use the app drawer to open an app unless all other ways have failed.
- Use the `input_text` action whenever you want to type something (including password) instead of clicking characters on the keyboard one by one. Sometimes there is some default text in the text field you want to type in, remember to delete them before typing.
- For `click`, `long_press` and `input_text`, the index parameter you pick must be VISIBLE in the screenshot and also in the UI element list given to you (some elements in the list may NOT be visible on the screen so you can not interact with them).
- Consider exploring the screen by using the `scroll` action with different directions to reveal additional content.
- The direction parameter for the `scroll` action can be confusing sometimes as it's opposite to swipe, for example, to view content at the bottom, the `scroll` direction should be set to "down". It has been observed that you have difficulties in choosing the correct direction, so if one does not work, try the opposite as well.
Text Related Operations
- Normally to select some text on the screen: <i> Enter text selection mode by long pressing the area where the text is, then some of the words near the long press point will be selected (highlighted with two pointers indicating the range) and usually a text selection bar will also appear with options like `copy`, `paste`, `select all`, etc. <ii> Select the exact text you need. Usually the text selected from the previous step is NOT the one you want, you need to adjust the range by dragging the two pointers. If you want to select all text in the text field, simply click the `select all` button in the bar.
- At this point, you don't have the ability to drag something around the screen, so in general you can not select arbitrary text.
